title: AI Assistant — JetBrains Agentic Coding Cheat Sheet
brandSub: AI Chat · Code Completion · In-Editor Actions · Agents · MCP · BYOK

rows.label: Install
rows.value: Settings | Plugins | Marketplace → search AI Assistant → Install

rows.label: IDEs
rows.value: IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm, Rider, CLion, PhpStorm, RubyMine, RustRover, DataGrip, DataSpell + Android Studio

rows.label: Activate
rows.value: Open AI Chat tool window → Start with JetBrains AI or Start Free Trial (30-day AI Pro)

rows.label: BYOK
rows.value: Click Bring your own API key → select provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, LM Studio…) → paste key

rows.label: Free tier
rows.value: AI Free: 3 AI Credits / 30 days; AI Pro: 10 credits/$10; AI Ultimate: 35 credits/$30

rows.label: Widget
rows.value: JetBrains AI widget in window header — check quota, subscription, disable per-project

rows.label: Disable project
rows.value: Widget → Disable for This Project; or create .noai in project root

rows.label: Min version
rows.value: IDE 2023.3+ required; Community Editions need 2024.1.1+

rows.label: Open
rows.value: Click AI Chat button on right toolbar (or assign a shortcut in Keymap → Tool Windows → AI Assistant)

rows.label: New chat
rows.value: ⌘N or click New Chat button — start fresh for every unrelated topic

rows.label: Switch mode
rows.value: ⌘/ to toggle Chat ↔ last selected agent

rows.label: Select model
rows.value: Click model name dropdown → pick from JetBrains AI, BYOK, or local models; Auto balances cost & quality

rows.label: Apply response
rows.value: Click Apply on a code snippet → review diff → Accept All or Discard All

rows.label: Codebase mode
rows.value: Enabled by default — AI gathers context automatically; disable via ⚙ → Enable Codebase Mode

rows.label: /commands
rows.value: /explain /refactor /docs /web /help — type / in chat to see full list

rows.label: Chat history
rows.value: Click 🕐 Chat History; search within chat via ⌘F

rows.label: @mentions
rows.value: @thisFile @selection @problems @localChanges @projectStructure @commit: @symbol:

rows.label: @file / @folder
rows.value: @file:Foo.kt or @folder:src/main — or drag & drop into chat

rows.label: Add image
rows.value: Click + Add attachment → Add Image (max 20 MB); select an image-capable model first

rows.label: UI context
rows.value: Add context from UI — attach terminal output, console logs, build results

rows.label: DB object
rows.value: Type @dbObject: to attach a schema or table (DataGrip & DB plugin, 2025.2+)

rows.label: Trim threshold
rows.value: Settings | AI Assistant → Trim message if it exceeds % of context window (prevents context overflow)

rows.label: Review attached
rows.value: Click any attachment chip to preview; expand Attachments in a response to see what was used

rows.label: Auto context
rows.value: Agents (Junie, Claude, Codex, Copilot) attach current open file & selection automatically — toggle via IDE context indicator

rows.label: Trigger
rows.value: Start typing — suggestions appear inline; or press ⌥⇧\ to invoke manually

rows.label: Accept all
rows.value: Tab — accept the full suggestion (configurable in popup → click ⚙)

rows.label: Accept word
rows.value: ⌥→ — accept suggestion word by word

rows.label: Accept line
rows.value: ⌘→ — accept suggestion line by line

rows.label: Reject
rows.value: Esc — dismiss; or just keep typing

rows.label: Default model
rows.value: Powered by Mellum (JetBrains FIM model); custom model assignable in Settings | Providers & API keys

rows.label: Configure
rows.value: Settings | Editor | General | Code Completion | Inline — choose Cloud / Local / Cloud & Local

rows.label: Policies
rows.value: Focused (default, precise), Balanced, Creative (all filters off)

rows.label: Enable
rows.value: Settings | Editor | General | Code Completion | Inline → Enable next edit suggestions

rows.label: Navigate & apply
rows.value: Tab — jump to suggestion; Tab again to apply; Esc to cancel

rows.label: Chain
rows.value: Enable Chain suggestions to auto-request next edit after accepting one

rows.label: Preview instantly
rows.value: Show edits with fewer confirmation prompts

rows.label: Refactoring-based
rows.value: Enable Suggest refactorings to include IDE refactoring actions (e.g. Rename) as triggers

rows.label: Not on Free
rows.value: Feature unavailable on AI Free tier

rows.label: Triggers
rows.value: Fixes formatting, corrects typos, propagates code changes to related locations

rows.label: AI Actions menu
rows.value: Select code → ⌥↩ → AI Actions; or right-click → AI Actions

rows.label: Generate code
rows.value: ⌘\ on empty line → type prompt → ↩; or right-click → AI Actions → Generate Code

rows.label: Edit selection
rows.value: Select code → ⌘\ → type modification prompt

rows.label: Explain code
rows.value: Select code → AI Actions → Explain Code; also works on RegExp, SQL fragments

rows.label: Generate docs
rows.value: Caret on declaration → AI Actions → Write Documentation (or type /** and press Enter in IDEA)

rows.label: Generate tests
rows.value: Caret in class/method → AI Actions → Generate Unit Tests → review in AI Diff tab → Accept All

rows.label: Find problems
rows.value: Select code → AI Actions → Find Problems

rows.label: Suggest refactoring
rows.value: Select code → AI Actions → Suggest Refactoring → Apply → Accept/Discard diff

rows.label: Commit message
rows.value: ⌘0 (Commit window) → click ✨ Generate Commit Message

rows.label: Custom commit prompt
rows.value: Gear in Commit window → AI Assistant section → edit Prompt for generation field; use $GIT_BRANCH_NAME

rows.label: Self-Review
rows.value: Select changes in Commit window → Self-Review with AI → review Problems tool window

rows.label: Explain commit
rows.value: VCS log → right-click commit → Explain Commit with AI Assistant

rows.label: PR description
rows.value: In PR tool window → click ✨ Generate Title and Description

rows.label: Merge conflicts
rows.value: Merge Revisions dialog → Merge with AI

rows.label: Shelf title
rows.value: Shelve Silently — AI generates the shelf name automatically

rows.label: Group with AI
rows.value: Commit window or VCS log → Group with AI (Experimental Features plugin) — sorts diffs by impact

rows.label: Select agent
rows.value: Click mode selector in AI Chat → choose Junie, Claude Agent, Codex, or GitHub Copilot

rows.label: Junie auth
rows.value: JetBrains AI subscription only; respects .aiignore

rows.label: Claude auth
rows.value: JetBrains AI, API key (Anthropic), or Anthropic Console

rows.label: Codex auth
rows.value: JetBrains AI, OpenAI API key, or ChatGPT account (OAuth)

rows.label: Copilot auth
rows.value: GitHub account (OAuth) only; no JetBrains AI or BYOK

rows.label: Brave / Auto mode
rows.value: Junie: enable Brave Mode; Claude: Bypass Permissions; Codex: Agent (full access)

rows.label: Rollback
rows.value: In changed files pane → hover file → ↩ to revert one file, or Rollback for all

rows.label: Instructions file
rows.value: AGENTS.md (Junie, Codex, Copilot) or CLAUDE.md (Claude) in repo root — version-controlled agent guidance

rows.label: JetBrains AI models
rows.value: Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), GPT/o-series (OpenAI), Grok (xAI) — accessed via JetBrains AI service

rows.label: BYOK providers
rows.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI-compatible, LM Studio, Ollama

rows.label: Configure BYOK
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Providers & API keys → select Provider → enter API key → Test Connection

rows.label: Local models
rows.value: Ollama or LM Studio: specify Base URL → Test Connection; default context window 64k tokens

rows.label: Assign models
rows.value: Core features, Instant helpers, Completion model fields in Providers & API keys (for local / OpenAI-compatible)

rows.label: Auto model
rows.value: Set model picker to Auto — AI Assistant picks best balance of performance & cost

rows.label: Model hints
rows.value: 🧠 = reasoning; 🖼 = image support; 💎 = high cost; β = beta

rows.label: JetBrains AI + BYOK
rows.value: Both can be active together; BYOK has priority, JetBrains AI fills unsupported features

rows.label: Connect MCP
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Model Context Protocol (MCP) → + Add → paste JSON config → Apply

rows.label: STDIO config
rows.value: {"mcpServers":{"name":{"command":"node","args":["/path/server.js"]}}}

rows.label: HTTP config
rows.value: {"mcpServers":{"name":{"url":"https://example.com/mcp"}}}

rows.label: Import from Claude
rows.value: Click Import from Claude to reuse existing Claude Desktop MCP config

rows.label: Invoke tools
rows.value: AI triggers tools automatically; or type / in chat to see available MCP commands

rows.label: IDE as MCP server
rows.value: Enable MCP Server plugin (bundled) → Settings | Tools | MCP Server → Auto-Configure clients

rows.label: ACP agents
rows.value: Chat mode selector → Install From ACP Registry or add custom ~/.jetbrains/acp.json

rows.label: Perforce MCP
rows.value: Settings | Version Control | Perforce | Perforce MCP → configure p4-mcp-server path

rows.label: Prompt Library
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Prompt Library — add, edit, reorder custom prompts

rows.label: Custom prompt
rows.value: Right-click editor → AI Actions → Add Your Prompts; use $SELECTION variable for selected code

rows.label: Modify built-in
rows.value: Prompt Library → select action (e.g. Commit Message Generation) → append instructions → Apply

rows.label: Save from chat
rows.value: Hover over prompt → ⋯ → Save Current Prompt → configure in Prompt Library dialog

rows.label: Project rules
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Rules → New Project Rules File → creates .aiassistant/rules/*.md

rows.label: Rule types
rows.value: Always, Manually (via @rule:), By model decision, By file patterns, Off

rows.label: Chat instructions
rows.value: Prompt Library → General → Chat Instructions — prepended to every new chat automatically

rows.label: Response language
rows.value: Settings | AI Assistant → Natural Language → Receive responses in a custom language

rows.label: ⌘\
rows.value: Generate code (empty line) or edit selected code in editor

rows.label: ⌥↩
rows.value: Open AI Actions context menu for selection

rows.label: Tab
rows.value: Accept full completion / next edit suggestion

rows.label: ⌥→
rows.value: Accept suggestion word by word

rows.label: ⌘→
rows.value: Accept suggestion line by line

rows.label: ⌥⇧\
rows.value: Manually invoke cloud code completion

rows.label: Esc
rows.value: Reject suggestion

rows.label: ⌘N
rows.value: New chat (in AI Chat window)

rows.label: ⌘/
rows.value: Switch between Chat mode and last selected agent

rows.label: ⌘F
rows.value: Search within current chat or in chat history list

rows.label: ⌘⇧'
rows.value: Maximize / restore AI Chat tool window

rows.label: .aiignore
rows.value: Create .aiignore (gitignore syntax) in project root to block files from AI processing; also supports .cursorignore / .aiexclude

rows.label: Enable .aiignore
rows.value: Settings | Tools | AI Assistant | Project Settings → enable .aiignore checkbox

rows.label: Detailed data
rows.value: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | System Settings | Data Sharing → Send detailed code-related data — disabled by default

rows.label: Data flow (JB AI)
rows.value: IDE → JetBrains AI service (no storage) → LLM provider → response back; JetBrains does not store unless opt-in enabled

rows.label: Data flow (BYOK)
rows.value: IDE → directly to your BYOK provider using your API key; JetBrains is not in the path

rows.label: Requests log
rows.value: Search Everywhere → Open AI Assistant Requests Log in Editor → review ai-assistant-requests.md

rows.label: Network block
rows.value: Block https://api.jetbrains.ai/ and https://api.app.prod.grazie.aws.intellij.net/ to disable at network level

rows.label: Org controls
rows.value: JetBrains Account (admin) → enable/disable AI Assistant per org; set monthly Top-up AI Credits limit per subscription

rows.label: One topic per chat
rows.value: Start a new chat for every unrelated task — stale context inflates quota and degrades answers

rows.label: Attach, don't describe
rows.value: Use @file:, @selection, or drag & drop instead of copy-pasting code into the prompt

rows.label: Plan before coding
rows.value: Ask an agent to outline a plan first; switch to Plan mode (Claude/Copilot) if available

rows.label: Define 'done'
rows.value: Include acceptance criteria — e.g. "run ./gradlew test and confirm green" — so the agent knows when to stop

rows.label: Scope small
rows.value: One change per request; send follow-ups for next steps rather than bundling everything

rows.label: Reuse good prompts
rows.value: Save effective prompts to Prompt Library; add standing conventions to a Project Rule or AGENTS.md

rows.label: Pick the right model
rows.value: Use a 🧠 reasoning model for complex logic; use a cheap/fast model for docs or commit messages

rows.label: Iterate, don't retry
rows.value: Send a focused follow-up ("keep structure, handle empty input") rather than a blank "try again"
